environment.working_tree: uncommitted Deno prototype and benchmark harness

methodology.latency: 3 rounds, 210 serial calls per workload/backend/round; 7 warmup calls per process; alternating backend order; timing includes RunCode cleanup; warm OS/cache, fresh Deno process per call
methodology.rss: Separate run: 70 measured + 7 warmup calls; process-tree RSS sampled via macOS libproc every ~1ms; RSS sums may double-count shared pages and miss short spikes; no heap allocation metric substituted for RSS
methodology.startup: Production Deno flags and embedded runner: launch to ready handshake plus kill/wait cleanup, no SDK/rule input; approximate startup contribution, not a tracing decomposition
